description: This file contains a Controller class for managing CMS articles in an OpenCart administrative context. It includes methods for listing, editing, saving, enabling, disabling, and deleting articles, along with handling permissions, SEO URLs, and related data.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS Articles in the admin panel of OpenCart, providing CRUD operations, status updates, and auxiliary functions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load and display the list of articles with filter options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of articles, mainly delegating to getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves, processes, and renders the list of articles based on filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and displays the article creation/edit form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (adding or editing) an article, including validation and SEO URL checks.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Schedules a task to recalculate or update article ratings.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected articles by updating their status.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected articles by updating their status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected articles from the database.
